translation: The lips and mouth (唇口) are the orifice that governs speech and eating. If the upper lip is broken and split by a fall or blow, use a small strip of silk, tie it from behind the head forward to bind it together; first use mulberry bark thread (桑白皮捻線) to sew it fixed, then apply Feng Kou Yao (封口藥), then apply Jie Xue Ointment (截血膏) to cover the Feng Kou Yao so that it does not open and fall off, and still avoid speaking. If the lower lip is injured and split, use a silk strip to bind it up from under the chin; the treatment is the same as the previous method.
